morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语文本中作为外语形式整体引用，不按马来语词缀拆分。is_root 仅表示此处没有马来语派生结构；该形式在拉丁语中本身是动词变位形式。无已核实的标准马来语读音。

senses.zh_definition: 拉丁语动词形式，意为“我等待；我期待”；常见于《哈利·波特》的咒语 Expecto Patronum，并非已核实的标准马来语词条。
senses.en_definition: A Latin verb form meaning ‘I await’ or ‘I expect’, familiar from the incantation Expecto Patronum; not an established standard Malay verb.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk kata kerja bahasa Latin yang bermaksud ‘saya menunggu’ atau ‘saya menjangkakan’, dikenali melalui ungkapan Expecto Patronum; bukan takrif entri bahasa Melayu yang disahkan oleh DBP.
senses.nuances: 这里只确认外语含义，不推定输入语料一定来自《哈利·波特》。拉丁语词典将 expect- 列作 exspect- 的拼写变体。下列搭配分别是固定咒语和马来语中的引用框架，不代表两个高频马来语词汇搭配。[Lewis and Short 拉丁语词典](https://logeion.uchicago.edu/exspecto)

collocations.zh: 呼神护卫；字面约为“我等待一位守护者”
collocations.en: the Patronus Charm incantation; approximately ‘I await a guardian’

messages.ms_spoken: Baru tahu. Maksudnya ‘saya menunggu’, kan? Aku ingat nama jampi je.
messages.ms_standard: Saya baru mengetahuinya. Maksudnya ‘saya menunggu’, bukan? Saya menyangka bahawa perkataan itu hanya nama jampi.

messages.en: I just found out. It means ‘I await’, right? I thought it was just a spell name.

etymology.historical_story: Expecto belongs to Latin rather than Malay word formation. Latin dictionaries recognize it alongside exspecto, associated with waiting or looking out for something. Modern readers often encounter it in Harry Potter’s Expecto Patronum, an incantation approximately meaning ‘I await a guardian’. Its appearance in Malay discussion therefore need not indicate lexical borrowing. [Official Harry Potter explanation](https://www.harrypotter.com/fr/features/the-etymology-of-harry-potter-spells)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 expecto 与英语 expect 联系起来：想到“期待守护者出现”，记住拉丁语“我等待”。这是记忆联想，不是马来语构词规则。
